summaryAnswer: Izanagi and Izanami are creator deities in Japanese myth who stir the sea with a jeweled spear, form Onogoro, marry, and give birth to islands and kami. After Izanami dies giving birth to the fire god Kagutsuchi, Izanagi follows her to Yomi, flees after seeing her decayed form, seals the underworld, and purifies himself, leading to the birth of Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi, and Susanoo.
